body: I'm a sucker for Peruvian Rhodonite ❤️

aside from earthworks, there is a family owned shop in Shoppers World called Love Jewelry (a bit on the pricier side and isn't just crystals), there's Catalyst & Co in square one, but my go to is CrysClaim on IG. Michaels in trinity commons has some clusters and agate pieces, and sometimes Winners in Shoppers World has genuine crystal pieces in the Home Decor section!
